text: Given two 2-digit numbers written in column form, the learner will compute their product using the standard column algorithm, producing both partial products with correct carries and a correct final sum.

text: Given the second row of a column multiplication, the learner will explain why a placeholder zero is written in the ones column before multiplying by the tens digit.
